label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Austin Championship logjam
items.text: Brian Harman is tied for the lead at 11-under par at the Austin Championship presented by Compliance Solutions with Kristoffer Ventura, Erik van Rooyen, and Trace Crowe also at -11 after Round 2; the cut line is projected at -3 at Fazio Canyons at Omni Barton Creek.

items.headline: McIlroy tied for DP World lead
items.text: Rory McIlroy birdied the 18th hole to finish the second round tied for the 36-hole lead with Tyrrell Hatton at 5-under 139 at the DP World Tour Championship in Dubai, keeping him on track to secure a record-tying eighth Race to Dubai title if he leads on Sunday.

items.headline: Van Rooyen backs PGA Tour stance
items.text: Erik van Rooyen carded a 64 at the Austin Championship and defended his demand that former LIV Golf players must earn their way back onto the PGA Tour.
